ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a flat spiral coil occupying an annular region. The label Do spans the full outside diameter of the spiral, and Di spans the central opening/inner diameter. The spiral turns are closely spaced and nearly touching, consistent with using the pipe outer diameter as the radial pitch. Reasoning: Use Do = 50 cm, Di = 20 cm, and pipe outer diameter do = 0.50 cm. The radial build of the spiral is (Do - Di)/2 = (50 - 20)/2 = 15 cm. Since adjacent pipe turns almost touch, the number of turns is approximately N = 15/0.50 = 30. Treat the spiral as many nearly circular turns with mean diameter Dmean = (Do + Di)/2 = (50 + 20)/2 = 35 cm. The total length is then L ≈ NπDmean = 30π(35 cm) = 3299 cm = 32.99 m, which rounds to 33 m.
